title: firmcall: a company's own Claude Code plugin and the rules on every computer
description: firmcall is a Claude Code plugin for the person who sets AI up in a company. From an interview about the company's frequent tasks it writes the company's own plugin - one skill per task with examples and tests - its private catalogue and a zip for the organisation's plugin library used by Cowork and chat. It writes the managed settings for every computer (a managed-settings.d drop-in, managed-mcp.json, the shared company-ai-policy.json), the same rules for the claude.ai admin console, a macOS configuration profile for Jamf and an Intune platform script for Windows, and a read-only row-level-security template for a database the agent reads. Its lint catches the settings that silently switch Remote Control off, a global ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, managed-only keys in user files and deny rules that only the console carries. Python standard library only, no network.
